_readme: SS-602. REDACTED EXAMPLE. This file is committed; the real one is not.
The real list lives at .denylist.local.json, which is gitignored. Copy this file to
that name and replace the terms. The terms themselves must never be committed: this
repository is public, so a denylist of client and employer identifiers would publish
exactly the identifiers it exists to keep off the site. That is not hypothetical -- it
is the same failure as a robots.txt Disallow advertising a private URL, which
netlify.toml already refuses to do for /jesse.
Matching is case-insensitive and whole-word by default. Set "substring": true on an
entry for fragments such as a contract-number prefix.
If .denylist.local.json is absent, SS-602 reports SKIPPED rather than passing. A rule
that silently passes when its input is missing is worse than no rule.

terms.note: employer, never named on the site
